chunks.text:
[Intro]
{spoken, flat, like a video call}
Can you see my screen?
Okay. Version one.
positive_styles: intro starts with a short spoken line over a filtered beat

chunks.text:
[Verse 1]
Make it pop
{gang shout} Which frame?
Make the logo bigger
{gang shout} Which frame?
Something's off at like three seconds
{gang shout} Which second?
No, the other thing
{gang shout} Which thing?
Give it more energy
Like Apple, but fun
Can we try it in blue?
{gang shout} Which blue?
I'll know it when I see it
positive_styles: female lead sings short sassy lines
male gang vocal answers each line with a loud short shout

chunks.text:
[Pre-Chorus]
Version two, version three
Final, final, final final
Version twelve, final final FINAL
Somebody point at the frame!

[Chorus]
Point at the frame
Tell it what to change
Click it, drag it, type it in
Finish review
Here comes version two

[Verse 2]
Pick a style, press use
Every color, every font
Pause it, click the thing that's off
Drag across the timeline
Every note gets a timestamp
Every note gets a frame
{robotic male voice} Agent's listening
{robotic male voice} Got three notes, making version two

[Chorus]
Point at the frame
Tell it what to change
Click it, drag it, type it in
Finish review
Here comes version two

[Bridge]
{fast, half spoken, question and answer}
Is it in the cloud?
{gang shout} It's on your machine
What's it cost?
{gang shout} Nothing, M I T
Does it need Hyperframes?
{gang shout} Any M P four
Cursor, Claude, Codex?
{gang shout} M C P!
positive_styles: stripped back bridge with kick and bass only
builds back up at the end

chunks.text:
[Final Chorus]
Point at the frame
Tell it what to change
Click it, drag it, type it in
Finish review
Version three, approved!

[Outro]
{spoken, flat, deadpan, music drops out}
I'm not describing timestamps anymore.
N P X Frame Jam install.
positive_styles: music stops, dry spoken female voice
one last synth stab at the very end
